rows.en: (Today I came to a restaurant with Claire-senpai!)

What a nice view...
Food tastes extra special in a place like this.
It really does.
Oh, the food's here!!

It was even more delicious than I imagined.
I'm amazed.

The meat was so tender, it melted on my tongue.
I've never had anything like it.
Let's come here together again, okay?
(Today I came to a restaurant with Claire-senpai.)
It really does!

The meat was so tender, it just melted on my tongue.
I've never had meat like that before.

(Today I came to the restaurant with Claire-senpai
again!)
The view here is lovely every time.

That meat is so good...
I wish it would hurry up and get here...
Senpai, you're such a glutton.
Hey, what's that supposed to mean...
Oh, the food's here~
This is a dish I could eat again and again.

I wonder how they cook it...
It amazes me no matter how many times I eat it.

(Today I came to the restaurant with Claire-senpai
again.)
Senpai, you're such a glutton~
(Claire-senpai and I came to the artificial island!)

Looking around like this without swimming
isn't bad either.
You can feel time flowing so leisurely.

It sure is.
It's like we've come to another world.

Hey, why don't we go down to the beach
for a bit?
Phew, we finally made it back.
Did we walk a little too much?
But it was fun.
Did you have fun too?

Of course!
Please hang out with me again!
Mm, I know.
rows.notes: x5: Claire here; also the female player in nml_mcl_002.

rows.en:
Be sure to invite me. Absolutely, okay?
Got it?
rows.notes: Claire tells the player to invite her next time (answers 'please hang out with me again').

rows.en: (Claire-senpai and I came to the artificial island.)

(Claire-senpai and I came to the artificial island
again!)

Looking around like this without swimming
isn't bad either.

You can feel time flowing so leisurely,
and the scenery looks different every time I come.

It sure does.
There's something new to discover every time.

Of course I did!
Please hang out with me again!

(Claire-senpai and I came to the artificial island
again.)

(Claire-senpai said she wanted to visit the school,
so here we are today!)
This brings back memories.
Well, I was still going here a year ago.

So it's only been that long.
It felt like such a long time ago.

Right... That means it's been a year since I met you.
Time really flies, doesn't it...

Sorry about today.
I dragged you to school just because I wanted to.

I don't mind at all.
It was nice to remember how things were
a year ago.
I wish I could've gone to school with you too...
Huh? Did you say something?

Nope, nothing.
Come on, let's head home?

(Claire-senpai said she wanted to visit the school,
so here we are today.)

Please don't worry about it!
It was nice to remember how things were
a year ago.

(Claire-senpai and I ended up hanging out
at school, but...)
This brings back memories~
Wait, what's with that face...
Well, Senpai... you're in uniform...

Wh-what's wrong with that!
I can still totally pull it off! Totally!
rows.notes: 'Mada zenzen seefu': she still passes as a student.

rows.en: What? You got a problem with that...?
N-no... No problem whatsoever!

Today was fun~
And I got to sneak onto campus, too.

You're a graduate, so I think you could
just walk in openly.
Geez... you just don't get it...
Well, whatever...

Let's go home together?
Hand in hand, okay?
Well, Senpai... you're in uniform, so...
